caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a lid and two rounded handles, one on each end, which curve outward. The box is rendered in shades of brown, giving it a varnished, polished wood appearance with visible wood grain patterns along the surface. The lid features two symmetrical round knobs situated close to each end for lifting the lid. The sides of the box are slightly slanted inwards toward the bottom, and the edges along the shorter sides are decorated with evenly spaced round wooden pegs or beads. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the detailed caramel-brown coloring and smooth texture of the box.
